scope: Free local CPU inference only; public model downloads; no SDK, remote inference, course uploads, or paid resources.
truncation: disabled; full tokenizer windows within each existing citable chunk, no dropped tail
query_aggregation: mean of normalized window vectors, then normalize
chunk_score: maximum cosine over a chunk's window vectors
cold_definition: Fresh Python process, not a flushed OS filesystem cache; separately time imports, Encoder construction, and first query encode.
query_text: How does retrieving an idea from memory help a student learn it?
peak_rss: Process ru_maxrss after all encodes; macOS reports bytes. This includes Python, libraries, model session and document batch high-water memory.
sizes: Report downloaded inference asset bytes separately from installed runtime dependency logical bytes. Neither is a measured final compressed app increment.
concurrency: No competing candidate benchmark or retrieval run during timing window; normal desktop activity cannot be fully controlled.
report: pooled warm query median and p95
document_suffix: Final two words of each 250-word passage are Passage INDEX.
